Stallion Group has partnered with Access Bank , part of Access Holdings, Nigeria’s largest banking group by total assets, to make vehicle ownership more accessible. The partnership brings 10 exclusive automotive brands and 72 models within reach of customers.
Through Access Bank’s AutoFest initiative, eligible buyers can access financing of up to 90% of their chosen vehicle’s value, with a minimum 10% Equity contribution for individual and20%-30% for Fleet Financing. Delivery may be possible within 72 hours after Equity Contribution, subject to credit approval and completion of documentation.
With more than 50 years in the automotive industry, Stallion Group brings an established portfolio of international brands, exclusive manufacturer relationships and extensive customer support capabilities to the partnership.
The offering extends beyond vehicle sales. Customers can access professional servicing, Optimised Cost of ownership, genuine spare parts, dedicated bodyshop facilities, manufacturer warranties of up to six years on eligible vehicles, and electric vehicle battery warranties of up to eight years, subject to manufacturer terms and conditions.
Flexible repayment options extending beyond four years given individuals and businesses the opportunity to acquire vehicles without paying the full purchase price upfront.
The partnership combines Stallion Group’s automotive heritage and after sales infrastructure with the financial strength and reach of one of Africa’s largest banking groups.
10 Brands. 72 Models. Up to 90% Financing. Potential Delivery in 72 Hours.
